thread:
alex.t: heads-up — AcmeCorp reported sudden SSO failures after an IdP cert rotation this morning. 100% of their users hitting 403 on the SAML callback.

maria_eng: thanks — any error details from our side?

alex.t: from app logs: `SAMLResponse validation failed: RecipientMismatch (expected https://app.redwood.com/saml/consume/tenant-acme, received https://app.redwood.com/saml/consume)`

alex.t: customer says their IdP (Okta) rotated signing certs and updated metadata. They confirmed ACS is set to the tenant-scoped URL. But our auth logs show requests coming in with the non-tenant ACS path (no tenant suffix).

jordan_se: odd — that suggests either metadata fetch saw an older entityID/ACS or our proxy is stripping the tenant path. Can we get the raw SAMLRequest/Response? @support_bot can you attach the last SAMLResponse blob?

support_bot: attached SAMLResponse (base64) from 10:12 UTC for request id 0x9f3a.

maria_eng: decoded the response — Audience/Recipient are set to the tenant URL. So IdP is sending correct ACS. Our front-end LB is rewriting host/path for a small subset of requests (we've seen similar with the global host rewrite rule).

alex.t: repro steps I ran in staging: 1) push a mock Okta metadata with dual-key certs and tenant ACS 2) rotate active cert -> our metadata poll pulls new cert 3) immediately do SSO login -> sometimes callback path gets normalized to the root consume path and SAML validator rejects it.

jordan_se: can confirm — looks like a timing window where our metadata watcher updates keys but the tenant routing table hasn't refreshed, causing the incoming request to hit a different route that expects a non-tenant ACS.

ops_oncall: assigning to ops_oncall for immediate mitigation. Suggested temporary fixes: (A) add a tolerant recipient check for tenant-less ACS during cert-rollovers for 10m window; (B) force metadata poll + routing table refresh after IdP cert change; (C) ask customer to hold on rotating until we confirm sync. Which do we want?

maria_eng: prefer B + a short safety fallback: add tolerant recipient only while we coordinate with the customer (needs security review). Jordan — can you draft a quick gating script that forces routing refresh after metadata change?

jordan_se: on it. Patch idea: after MetadataWatchdog detects a signature/key rotation for a tenant, post an event to RouterService to refresh tenant rules and invalidate route cache for that tenant. Patch and deploy to staging now.

alex.t: contacting AcmeCorp to ask them to pause further rotations and to provide recent metadata URL. Also sharing repro steps and ETA ~30m for staging patch.

ops_oncall: triage note: severity P1 for customer-facing auth break. Action items: Jordan deploys router refresh script; Maria coordinates security signoff for tolerant recipient fallback; Alex updates customer and collects metadata URL; Ops monitors 403 rate and switches rollback if needed.

maria_eng: logging the incident for postmortem and follow-up: will include timeline, root cause (routing-table lag vs metadata poll order), and a recommended safe rollout checklist for IdP rotations.

alex.t: thanks all, will update thread with customer response. :thumbsup:
